topic: Anuradha — Mitra, the friendship that survives distance (NK serial deep-dive reel, English, 2026-09-06 pm)

slides.sub: The nakshatra of Mitra — friendship, and the contracts that hold it

slides.body:
Anuradha spans 3°20′ to 16°40′ of Vrishchika (Scorpio), the seventeenth of the twenty-seven nakshatras.

Its ruling planet is Shani (Saturn), sitting in a sign owned by Mangal (Mars). That pairing — Saturn's patience inside Mars's intensity — is the whole character of this nakshatra in one line.

The previous nakshatra, Vishakha, carries the older name Radha. Anuradha means anu-radha — the one that follows Radha.

The order matters. Vishakha is the nakshatra of goal and ambition; Anuradha comes after it. Tradition reads the sequence as the ambition being followed by the people you need in order to reach it.

Its deity is Mitra, one of the Adityas — the solar deities of the Vedic tradition. The Sanskrit word mitra means friend, and the deity presides over friendship, alliance, and the keeping of agreements.

In the Vedas Mitra is almost always invoked alongside Varuna. Tradition pairs them deliberately: Varuna holds cosmic law, Mitra holds the human bond that makes law liveable.

Anuradha's symbols are the lotus and the triumphal archway.

The lotus is traditionally read as something that flowers in difficult water — Vrishchika is not an easy sign, and the lotus does not pretend otherwise. The archway is what a group passes through together. Neither symbol is about a solitary achievement, which is the point.

points: Devotion — its shakti is traditionally described as the power of worship
Friendship across distance — bonds that survive separation and time
Organising people — Mitra's gift is holding a group together
Saturn's patience in Mars's sign — slow loyalty over quick heat
Deva gana — classed among the deva-natured nakshatras

slides.body:
Tradition does not present any nakshatra as purely fortunate. Anuradha's difficulty is the other face of its gift: loyalty held past the point where it serves anyone, and a tendency to carry a group's weight quietly rather than say the thing out loud.

And as always — the nakshatra is one layer. House, sign, dispositor and dasha all sit on top of it.

Comment if it is — or name the friend you have kept across cities and years, which is the most Anuradha thing there is.

Save this reel, and follow along: the serial is walking all twenty-seven in order.
